subject: Medicure Azure private plan: contract redlines & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@medicure.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medicure.com>, procurement@medicure.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Medicure: request for Azure Marketplace private plan terms & procurement checklist

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to gather the commercial and compliance artifacts so we can review an Azure private plan purchase. Can you send: 

- A proposed Master SaaS Agreement / SOW for Azure private plan (redlines welcome)
- Billing flow for Azure private plan (how marketplace invoicing vs. direct works)
- Evidence: SOC 2 report or SOC2 summary, data residency / retention statement, and any KMS/HSM info
- Typical onboarding timeline and contact for entitlement/merchant portal provisioning

I've attached our original RFP (Medicure-RFP-20270512.pdf) for context. Targeting procurement review next week — what do you need from our side?

Appreciate it,
Sara
Sara Liu
Head of Procurement
Medicure Health
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@medicure.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medicure.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medicure: request for Azure Marketplace private plan terms & procurement checklist

Sara — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses inline, and I've attached our initial redline and an RFP response stub for your legal/procurement review. Attachments: Azure-PrivatePlan-Terms-Redline.docx, Medicure-RFP-response.pdf.

Summary / next steps:
- Contract: attached redline is our starting point. Key negotiable items are payment path (marketplace vs direct), termination and refund language, and SLA credits.
- Billing: for Azure private plans we support both marketplace merchant-of-record and direct invoicing; merchant portal setup typically takes 2–3 business days after PO + merchant enrollment. I'll include billing flow in the doc.
- Evidence: SOC2 summary included in the RFP response; for full SOC 2 report we can provide an auditor letter under NDA. Data residency: our Private deployment supports regional tenancy in Azure (US East/West) — details in the attachment.
- Onboarding: entitlement provisioning + console access usually 5 business days after signature and PO.

I would like to loop in Legal to confirm redlines — Irene, Markus: could you review the attached redline and call out anything we should push back on (indemnity cap, data deletion SLA, IP license scope)?

Sara — if you can confirm a target procurement review date I will prioritize the legal response and prepare a DocuSign route. If you prefer a quick sync, I'm available Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Azure-PrivatePlan-Terms-Redline.docx (docx), Medicure-RFP-response.pdf (pdf)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@medicure.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medicure.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medicure: request for Azure Marketplace private plan terms & procurement checklist

Thanks for the loop, Avery. I reviewed Azure-PrivatePlan-Terms-Redline.docx and uploaded a clean summary (Legal-Redlines-20270517.pdf). High-level position below — happy to discuss on a brief 30-min call.

Key points and recommended stances:
- Payment path / revenue recognition: Accept merchant portal billing for procurement simplicity, but add a 60-day invoice dispute window and explicit reversal flow. (Concession ok)
- Indemnity & liability cap: Maintain existing Redwood cap tied to fees paid in prior 12 months; offer carve-out for gross negligence and willful misconduct. Oppose open-ended liability. (Stand firm)
- Data residency & deletion: Confirmed we can provide regional tenancy + deletion SLA (30 days) for cached inference data; offer a 90-day retention default with opt-in shorter retention. Require customer to provide written attestation if they need on-prem-only. (Negotiable)
- SLA / credits: Offer service credits up to 25% of monthly fees for sustained outages; exclude scheduled maintenance and customer misconfiguration. (Standard)
- Audit / SOC2: Provide SOC2 type II summary publicly; full report under NDA. Will provide auditor contact for topical questions. (Okay)
- IP / license: Redwood retains model IP and grants customer limited license to use outputs. Recommend we avoid broad customer-assigned IP transfer language. (Stand firm)

I propose we return the redline to Medicure with the Legal-Redlines PDF summarizing our approach and a clean markup showing the changes. Also include a one-page procurement checklist: PO needed, merchant enrollment steps, expected timelines, and billing contact.

Avery — I'll draft the legal summary and a one-page checklist by EOD PST. Markus — please flag any commercial trade-offs (especially billing or SLA credit %) you want me to consider.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Legal-Redlines-20270517.pdf (pdf)
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medicure.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@medicure.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medicure: request for Azure Marketplace private plan terms & procurement checklist

Irene / Avery — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear trade-offs. A few quick clarifications from procurement/legal here at Medicure: 

- Merchant billing vs direct: we prefer merchant-of-record to simplify our vendor management, but need a clear invoice dispute process and a named billing contact for chargebacks. Your proposed 60-day window is acceptable.
- Data deletion SLA: 30 days is more aggressive than our baseline — can you confirm the exact deletion workflow and whether certificates/logs will be provided after deletion?
- Liability cap: our legal team will try to push for a higher cap given PHI exposure; can your team provide an escalated insurance certificate or evidence of cyber insurance limits?

If you can provide the Legal-Redlines PDF and the one-page procurement checklist (with merchant enrollment URL and contact), we can run the internal procurement review on Thursday.

Also — happy to take a 30-min call Thursday 10am EST if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Tom Ellis
Director, Vendor Management
Medicure Health
